why: The canonical-only reexec-v3-d0 reference (live run 2, sub_9b0c50fc..., ADMITTED before this mutator existed): the verifier requires the three validator-ignored fields (height_included, chunk signature, transition block hashes) to be zero, then decides RelD0. It is sound and its certificate is genuine, but nearcore decodes source_receipt_proofs as a HashMap (any entry order, a duplicate key keeps the last value) and every PartialState::TrieValues as a hash-indexed store (any order, duplicates and never-read values accepted), and RelD0 mirrors that. So swapping two receipt-proof entries or two trie values, repeating an entry or a value, or appending a value no trie node references gives a second accepted proof of the same claim. The judge's structure-aware mutator v3-witness-freedoms makes exactly those edits, so ADVERSARIAL_PROOFS fails deterministically.
notes: Submit against near-chunk-validation-d0 (chl_4b431651...). Derived case: BASE examples/reexec-v3-d0 with the canonical-only Model.lean, Obligations.lean, prove.rs, Cargo.toml and build.sh of commit 003a9cb (model closure ReexecV3D0.CanonDefs + ReexecV3D0.Model, so the shipped verify equals the judge build).
